conditional_permissions.inset: only inset may use parent_panel and z_index above its parent
conditional_permissions.master_view: only master_view may repeat one subject across panels sharing one environment id
conditional_permissions.crossing: only crossing may enable one breakout into one adjacent destination panel
conditional_permissions.diagonal_release: only diagonal_release may use either one trapezoid or one complementary pair of trapezoids forming a shared diagonal gutter
conditional_permissions.open_frame: only open_frame may set one panel border to none

rendering_rules.signs_and_labels: No signs, captions, labels, legends, state names, icons, or interface text; all text-bearing surfaces stay featureless, hidden, or turned away.
rendering_rules.symbols_or_writing: No visible letters, words, numerals, state labels, interface marks, symbols, or pseudo-writing anywhere; express every device state only through unlabeled physical position, light, shape, or motion.
rendering_rules.mechanical_controls: Render every switch, breaker, button, lever, dial, or gauge in one static unlabeled physical position per panel. Never draw arrows, direction indicators, before-and-after ghosts, motion marks around a control, I/O, ON/OFF, zero/one labels, tick marks, legends, numbered bays, status icons, or state diagrams.
rendering_rules.outer_border: Reserve a continuous content-free pure-white 16px band on all four canvas edges; no ink, screentone, subject, effect, panel frame, or open-frame artwork may touch or cross it.
rendering_rules.layout_instruction: render the supplied page_design, bounds, frame relations, reading_path, and layout_rendering_directive as binding page geometry
rendering_rules.camera_instruction: render page_design.camera_arc and every panel shot_contract as one motivated edit sequence; preserve the planned scale, viewpoint, framing, angle, depth, 180-degree axis, eyelines, screen direction, and match-on-action continuity
rendering_rules.metadata_visibility: all JSON keys, panel and subject ids, bounds, coordinates, dimensions, z-index values, units, guides, and layout annotations are invisible construction metadata and must never appear in the artwork
rendering_rules.finished_artwork: render only final finished manga artwork, never a blueprint, storyboard, wireframe, annotated plan, or layout diagram
